theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U A : Set (Euclid P)) (S : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)) (Y : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)) (π : Euclid P → Euclid P) (G L : ℝ), IsOpen U → IsMinimizingIn S A → S.support ⊆ A → 0 < G → closedBall (0 : Euclid P) G ⊆ U → 0 ≤ L → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 π (ball 0 (2 * G)) → MapsTo π (ball 0 (2 * G)) A → (∀ y ∈ A ∩ ball 0 (2 * G), π y = y) → (∀ y ∈ ball 0 (2 * G), ‖π y‖ ≤ 2 * ‖y‖) → (∀ y ∈ ball 0 (2 * G), ∀ z ∈ ball 0 (2 * G), ‖π y - π z‖ ≤ L * ‖y - z‖) → IsIntegerMultiplicity Y → Y.boundary = 0 → IsCompact Y.support → Y.support ⊆ ball 0 (G / 2) → S.massOn (ball 0 G) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (L ^ (m + 1)) * (S - (0 - Y.restrictDomain (subset_univ U))).massOn (ball 0 G)
